title: Hypertension care cascade, adults 18+, NFHS-5 (2019-21), with absolute numbers derived by applying cascade percentages to ICMR-INDIAB's 315 million adults 20+ with hypertension (2021). Derived cross-source figures are labelled.
source: Percentages: Varghese et al., JAMA Network Open 2023 (NFHS-5). Population base: ICMR-INDIAB-17, Lancet Diabetes & Endocrinology 2023. Absolute numbers are author-derived, not published.
